$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$Root = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Proof'
if (-not (Test-Path $Root)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Root | Out-Null }
$Repo = Join-Path $Root 'repo'
git clone --no-checkout $RepositoryUrl $Repo
Set-Location -LiteralPath $Repo
git fetch origin $Branch --prune
$Actual = (git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD).Trim()
if ($Actual -ne $Expected) { throw 'head mismatch' }
python scripts/validate_harness.py --report Outputs/harness-completeness-report.json
$Registry = Get-Content harness/artifacts.v1.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
Get-Content Outputs/harness-completeness-report.json -Raw
